name: supplier_certificates
title: Supplier certificates
description: A supplier's certificates on file in Ledgerline (UN 38.3 cell-safety and others): type, document reference, valid-to date, whether each is valid today and how many days are left. Give item_code to also learn whether that item needs a valid UN 38.3 certificate (Purchase Policy §6.2) and whether this supplier has one.

supplier_code.description: Ledgerline supplier code, from find_supplier, e.g. NC-GDA-0063

item_code.description: optional item code, e.g. BAT-500: also says whether this item needs UN 38.3 and whether the supplier qualifies

cert_type.description: optional: only this certificate type, e.g. UN38.3

limit.description: optional: at most this many certificates per page (default 20, at most 50)

cursor.description: optional: the next_cursor from the previous page

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

certificates.description: one per certificate on file, newest valid-to first

un38_3.description: the supplier's best UN 38.3 certificate today

needs_un38_3.description: the item contains or charges lithium cells (Ledgerline's cell_safety flag)

supplier_qualifies.description: false when the item needs UN 38.3 and the supplier has no valid one

next_cursor.description: pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page

policy.on_busy_or_lost_reply: retry the read, at most 2 more times
policy.after_retries: ok=false, ledgerline_code ERR-SYS-0503 or TIMEOUT, with next_step

release_notes.1.0: 3 Nov 2026: new tool, built in Lecture 4.
